verdict.rationale: ADK is a code-first framework: agents are defined in your own Python code, can be packaged as containers to run in any environment (including offline, with no Google Cloud connection), and can use non-Google and local models. That makes leaving technically feasible and limits lock-in. Eval sets are plain .evalset.json files, but the evidence never documents any way to export runtime data such as sessions, state, memory, or artifacts in open formats. Missing for 10: a documented data-export feature for sessions, state, memory and artifacts; a statement of the open storage formats used; independent corroboration of data portability.
